paper.title: Transformer Autoencoder-Assisted Evolutionary Framework for Constrained Multiobjective 3D Wind Farm Layout Optimization

admission_scope: bounded deterministic end-to-end engineering reconstruction on the six declared P3 proxy cases

paper_visible_semantics.latent_crossover: exactly one uniformly selected dimension from mutant and every remaining dimension from current raw latent h
paper_visible_semantics.survival: merge parent and evaluated offspring populations then CDP plus NSGA-II environmental selection to N

declared_identity_critical_completions.relative_fitness: SPEA2 strength plus raw fitness plus density, ordered through CDP and min-max normalized to [0,1]; zero range maps every target to 0
declared_identity_critical_completions.cdp_rule: lower positive constraint violation wins; if both feasible compare Pareto dominance; otherwise continue to deterministic NSGA-II rank, crowding, and source-index ties
declared_identity_critical_completions.spea2_density_k: floor(sqrt(population_size)), at least 1, using the kth Euclidean objective-space neighbor after per-objective min-max normalization
declared_identity_critical_completions.tournament: binary tournament sampled with replacement; CDP first, then lower NSGA-II rank, then larger crowding distance, then smaller stable source index
declared_identity_critical_completions.latent_bounds: per-dimension minimum and maximum raw h observed in the current parent population; zero-range dimensions remain at the current value
declared_identity_critical_completions.polynomial_mutation_bounds: Deb bounded polynomial mutation within the current observed raw-latent bounds, followed by clamping
declared_identity_critical_completions.gaussian_covariance: sample x and y from the nonconflicting turbines' full 2 by 2 covariance; add max(cell_width squared times 1e-6, 1e-12) to each diagonal
declared_identity_critical_completions.gaussian_sampling: fixed-order Box-Muller draws; at most 64 projected samples per conflicting turbine
declared_identity_critical_completions.nearest_cell_tie: minimum squared planar distance, then smaller 1-based cell index
declared_identity_critical_completions.repair_fallback: if a Gaussian attempt cannot select an admissible unoccupied cell, choose the smallest admissible unoccupied cell; more than two conflicts reinitializes the full layout
declared_identity_critical_completions.duplicate_refill: discard offspring duplicate to a prior accepted offspring or identical to any current parent; attempt latent proposals at most 10 times the requested batch, then attempt deterministic uniformly sampled feasible refill at most another 10 times the requested batch and fail closed if still incomplete
declared_identity_critical_completions.partial_generation: request exactly min(population_size, remaining physical FES) unique offspring and evaluate no layout beyond the requested physical-FES cap
declared_identity_critical_completions.pretraining_checkpoint: bounded profile may construct deterministic bounded pretraining state; paper-scale profile requires an input checkpoint whose SHA-256 is supplied and whose metadata records the paper-scale profile, 100000 corpus samples, and at least 500 pretraining epochs
declared_identity_critical_completions.front_ties: stable source order followed by lexicographic ascending layout cells
declared_identity_critical_completions.unsupported_backends: hybrid and gpu fail closed; cpu is the only supported backend

conflicts: duplicate turbine cell after integer decoding
overlap with one of the selected P3 case's four monitor cells
repair_contract.at_most_two: retain nonconflicting cells and repair conflicts from the declared Gaussian rule
repair_contract.more_than_two: discard the complete decoded layout and generate a fresh uniform feasible sorted layout
repair_contract.output: exactly 15 unique admissible 1-based cells in ascending order

physical_work.unit: one complete call evaluating reciprocal power, A-weighted noise, cost, and normalized constraint violation for one layout
physical_work.fitness_target_reuse: fine-tuning uses already evaluated current-population values and performs no evaluator call

parallel_contract.cpu: one persistent executor parallelizes independent complete-layout evaluations
parallel_contract.ordered_state: initialization, tournaments, latent variation, repair, duplicate filtering, model training, environmental selection, hashes, and output serialization remain in deterministic fixed event order
parallel_contract.worker_equivalence: workers 1 and 20 must match physical FES, model hash, front hash, layout hash, and all scientific output fields exactly

required_outputs: case ID and problem semantic hash
seed, requested workers, physical FES, generations
training-state profile ID and actual model architecture
claim_boundary: Executable bounded M3 declared reconstruction on a declared P3 problem proxy only. It is not the unavailable original taae method, Zhangbei numerical case, reported Pareto front, paper-scale trained state, formal evidence, performance result, or GPU implementation.
